name: 808 Clean
author: DAW project (synthesized)
desc: Deep, clean TR-808 style sub bass (sine + pitch drop, ~4.5 s decay). Hip-hop/trap/R&B bass: follow the kick & root notes in MIDI 24-48 (C1-C3); note length = how long it booms. glide>0 + overlapping notes = 808 slide. Mono (new note cuts the last). | 808 recipe: slide = glide 0.06-0.15 and let the next note start before the previous ends (overlap ~1/16); glidecurve 0.5 = even, 0.8-1 = late trap/drill slide; release (x0.08 s tail) 0.35 = short knock, 2.5 = trap, 4+ = long boom. Always mono and centred (sub safe).
